_note: S334: the studio publishes its live-data surfaces (/stats/, /stats/ecosystem/, /status/, /studio-pulse/, /oracle/, /notebook/, /ignis-health/) that all answer versions of one question — 'is this studio real and working?' — with no front door. This file defines the spine. Each lane keeps its deep page as the canonical destination; the hub only routes and stamps freshness, so no receipt or permalink moves. S335: the /proof/ verifier was folded INTO the hub — its lane points at the on-page anchor /evidence/#verify (validateLanes accepts only anchors the generator renders) and /proof/ is an edge 301. `feed` must be a public, publicSafe JSON artifact carrying generatedAt; a lane whose feed cannot be read reports UNKNOWN rather than a stale green. S368: /stats/ folded in as the on-page #numbers section (lane id "scale" so the card id never collides with the section id); /notebook/ and /oracle/ retired to /studio-pulse/#forge-ledger and /ignis/#oracle.
